repos_data.description: Fast, dependency-free Go package to infer binary file types based on the magic numbers header signature
A Go package for media type and file extension detection, based on magic numbers

repo_meta_data.description: Powerful and versatile MIME sniffing package using pre-compiled glob patterns, magic number signatures, XML document namespaces, and tree magic for mounted volumes, generated from the XDG shared-mime-info database.
